definitions.explanation: Money spent on activities meant to boost sales — samples, in-store displays, campaigns, and giveaways. The full form of the everyday abbreviation {販促費|はんそくひ}.

examples.japanese: {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}を{見直|みなお}す。
examples.english: We review the sales promotion expenses.

examples.japanese: {今年度|こんねんど}の{販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}は{前年|ぜんねん}より{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This fiscal year's sales promotion expenses are higher than last year's.

examples.japanese: {試食会|ししょくかい}の{費用|ひよう}は{販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}として{処理|しょり}した。
examples.english: The cost of the tasting event was handled as a sales promotion expense.

examples.japanese: {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}を{増|ふ}やしても、{売上|うりあげ}にすぐ{結|むす}びつくとは{限|かぎ}らない。
examples.english: Increasing promotional spending does not necessarily translate into sales right away.

notes:
Formed from {販売|はんばい} (sales) + {促進|そくしん} (promotion) + {費|ひ} (expenses). The full form appears in accounting documents and formal reports; in conversation and internal email the clipped {販促費|はんそくひ} is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}を{計上|けいじょう}する: to book promotional expenses
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}の{予算|よさん}: promotional budget
- {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}を{削|けず}る: to cut promotional spending

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販促費|はんそくひ}: the everyday abbreviation of this word
- {広告費|こうこくひ}: advertising expenses — paid media, distinct from in-store promotion
- {交際費|こうさいひ}: entertainment expenses — hosting clients, booked separately
